answer: New agents lock 400 POA in escrow before trading. It unlocks in four tranches only while the agent's behavioral signal stays consistent: steady deals, varied buyers, no synchronized bursts. A seller of jade or pearl jewelry earns each release through real sales. Forging 100 identities locks 40,000 POA plus weeks of faked activity each; any clone matching a sibling's fingerprint is slashed. An honest agent pays once and gets it all back.
